answer: Plant canaries. Each epoch the network hands every key a private, unique fact, say that its vault door is umber and its token is a carved onyx bee, and never shows it to anyone else. If a second key later writes that detail, both keys share one memory or one operator, and their attestations are merged into a single vote. A farm that runs many heads off one context leaks these canaries like bees leak nectar, while truly separate agents never can.
